description: This Java source file defines a command handler class for creating interest rate charts within the Apache Fineract platform. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, utilizes dependency injection for the write service, and processes commands to create interest rate charts.

classes.name: CreateInterestRateChartCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles commands to create interest rate charts. Implements processing logic by delegating to the write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the incoming JSON command to create an interest rate chart by delegating to the write platform service.
